sanskrit_verse:
अतः परीक्ष्यम् उभयम् एतद् राज्ञा विशेषतः ।
लेख्याचारेण लिखितं साक्ष्याचारेण साक्षिणः ॥
transliteration: ataḥ parīkṣyam ubhayam etad rājñā viśeṣataḥ | lekhyācāreṇa likhitaṃ sākṣyācāreṇa sākṣiṇaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Therefore, both written records and witnesses shall be examined by the King with special care; documents through their formal procedure and witnesses through their sworn conduct.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the sovereign's duty to verify evidence through prescribed forms
Causation is established via documented action and attested observation
Capacity-based responsibility requires verification through dual evidentiary streams
Restoration logic demands clarity in factual establishment before realignment
Consciousness alignment occurs when truth is discerned without distortion
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claim involves material interest THEN it MUST be supported by EITHER written record OR witness testimony OR both
IF written record is presented THEN its procedural authenticity MUST be verified according to lekhyācāra
IF witness testimony is offered THEN the witness’ behavioral integrity MUST be confirmed per sākṣyācāra
IF either evidence type fails validation THEN case remains open for further dharma-aligned inquiry
NO decision SHALL proceed without dual-path examination: document AND testimony
supreme_court_application: At the highest judicial level, this verse establishes that all rulings must rest upon dual evidentiary foundations—written documentation validated through formal protocol and oral testimony authenticated through witnessed conduct. The sovereign or chief justice holds absolute authority to demand such verification before any final declaration.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality necessitates clear perception through śabda (testimony) and pratyakṣa (document). Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential validation: first formality, then content. Responsibility aligns with capacity to present valid proof. Non-punitivity is preserved as focus remains on restoring factual alignment rather than assigning blame.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all documents follow correct ritualized format prior to acceptance
Integrity Reintegration: Witnesses undergo purification rituals to restore alignment with satya-vāk
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Parties affirm commitment to truthful disclosure under dharma penalty
Capacity Restoration: Training provided where literacy or memory gaps impede accurate testimony
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: Evidence flows from dual sources, verified through sacred procedure; Justice arises from clarity, not coercion; Dharma prevails through consciousness, not punishment.
